$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.Enabled: true: AI doctrine is active (levels, ranges, withdrawals below apply to enemy soldiers). false: doctrine is not applied. Can also be switched at runtime with #aidoctrine on/off.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.TelemetryMinutes: Minutes. Interval between doctrine summaries printed in the server log (fire decisions allowed or refused, withdrawals, current weather factors). 0 or less: no summary.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.BandMedium: Meters. Distance from which a target counts as medium range instead of close. The per-level lists Memory, Reaction and Aim hold one value per band: close, medium, long, very long.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.BandLong: Meters. Distance from which a target counts as long range instead of medium.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.BandVeryLong: Meters. Distance from which a target counts as very long range instead of long.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.FactorMachineGun: Multiplier on the open-fire range of a soldier armed with a machine gun (rifles use 1).
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.FactorSniper: Multiplier on the open-fire range of a soldier armed with a sniper rifle (rifles use 1).
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.FactorHandgun: Multiplier on the open-fire range of a soldier armed with a handgun (rifles use 1). Launchers, grenades and cannons are not covered by doctrine.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.FogFactor: Range factor in the thickest fog. Ranges go from x1 in clear air down to this value as the fog level rises to 1 (thermal sights are less affected, see ThermalFogExponent).
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.SpottedAngle: Degrees (clamped 1 to 90). A target whose head points at a soldier within this angle has probably seen him, and the soldier's fire discipline (waiting to open fire) ends.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.OpenFireSeconds: Seconds. Once one man of a group has fired, the others are no longer hiding: fire discipline is over for the whole group for this long.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawMinDistance: Meters. Tactical withdrawal. When the nearest known enemy is closer than this, a group fights instead of running.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawOdds: A group withdraws when it has lost men lately or cannot see who fires at it, otherwise when the number of living known enemies times this value reaches or exceeds its own number of men.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawReplySeconds: Seconds. Time the group fires back during a withdrawal.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawSeconds: Seconds. Longest duration of a withdrawal.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawWaveSeconds: Seconds. Turn of each half of the group to move while the other half backs away firing, then they swap. Minimum 2.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.RegroupSeconds: Seconds. Time the group regroups before its new approach after a withdrawal.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawSafeSeconds: Seconds. The withdrawal ends once nobody has fired at the group for this long.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawBound: Meters. How far behind him a soldier running for cover looks for it during a withdrawal.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.WithdrawForgetSeconds: Seconds (minimum 60). After a group has come back from a withdrawal, a contact after this delay is a new fight with its withdrawals available again. Men lost within this delay also make a withdrawal likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.DoubtSeconds: Seconds (clamped 60 to 150). Without news of the enemy for this long, a group lifts the doubt and goes back to its waypoint.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.DefendLeash: Meters. How far from its post a group with a defend waypoint goes to an enemy. 0: only inside the waypoint radius, as vanilla.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.MoveLeash: Meters. How far from the last waypoint it reached a group on the move goes to an enemy.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.CloseContact: Meters. An enemy this close to the group is one it deals with whatever its leash says.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.RainFactor: Range factor in the heaviest rain. Ranges go from x1 in dry weather down to this value as rain intensity rises to 1.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.FiredAtEnvFloor: Lowest range factor (weather, fog, night) against someone firing at the group: muzzle flash and sound give him away in fog and dark.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.NightFactor: Range factor at night for a soldier with the naked eye (x1 by day).
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.NightAim: Aim error factor at night for the naked eye, on top of the vanilla x2 on a badly lit target (x1 by day).
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.DefaultLevel: Level (from LevelNames) given to a soldier when no AssignPrefab or AssignFaction rule matches. If it does not exist, Grunt is used.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.Weather: List of 'Weather state name=factor'. Factor multiplied into every range while the game's weather state has that name (1 = no change). States not listed use 1.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.AssignPrefab: List of 'word=Level'. A soldier whose prefab name contains the word gets that level. Checked first, in order, first match wins.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.AssignFaction: List of 'FactionKey=Level'. A soldier of that faction (and matching no AssignPrefab rule) gets that level. First match wins, then DefaultLevel.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.LevelNames: Names of the levels loaded from Levels. A name with no entry in Levels is created with default values; a level in Levels but not listed here is not loaded.
$profile:INDFORGE_AIDoctrine/config.json.Levels: One object per level name of LevelNames. Fields of a level: RangeStand, RangeCrouch, RangeProne (meters at which he opens fire on a still target standing, crouched, prone, in clear weather); RangeMin (meters: never refused for range under this distance); MovingFactor (range factor on a moving target); ReturnFireFactor and ReturnFireSeconds (range factor on a target that just fired at him, and for how many seconds); SharedFactor (range factor when the group already identified the target); AloneFactor and AloneSize (range factor when the group is reduced to AloneSize men or fewer); LargeFactor and LargeSize (range factor when it has LargeSize men or more); Memory (seconds he keeps firing at where a target was after losing sight, one value per band: close, medium, long, very long); ReturnFireMemoryFactor (Memory factor on a target that just fired at him); StressMemory (Memory grows with stress: 0 calm, 1 doubles it at full stress); Reaction (seconds between first seeing a new target and the first shot, per band); Aim (aim error factor, per band); StressAim (aim error grows with stress: 1 doubles it at full stress); BurstRange (meters: rifles fire bursts up to this distance, then single shots, machine guns always burst); Stalk (0.1 to 1: share of his range at which he opens fire on a target that has not noticed him, 1 = as soon as he may); Patience (seconds he holds fire once a target is within his full range, then he takes the shot or a target walking away goes free); Withdrawals (times a group withdraws, regroups and comes back before it fights it out); SuppressRate (fire rate factor on a position he cannot see); SuppressRange (meters: furthest distance of group suppression of a position); SuppressMemory (seconds of suppression after the last news of the position); Perception (factor on the engine's perception: how fast he notices). A list with the wrong number of values is ignored.

$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightDirect: Multiplier on the score of the direct plan (one group, search and destroy, the fallback when no plan fits better). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely, 1 = unchanged. If every plan scores 0 the HQ still falls back to direct.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightFixFlank: Multiplier on the score of the L-shaped attack (one group fixes the target, a second strikes from a flank at 90 degrees; never against vehicles). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightHammerAnvil: Multiplier on the score of the hammer and anvil plan (a group blocks the route of a moving target, the other pushes it onto the block; moving targets only). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightMortarFirst: Multiplier on the score of the mortar-first plan (recon-strike mortar fire, then the assault once the fire lifts; needs mortars, never against vehicles). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightInfiltration: Multiplier on the score of the infiltration plan (special forces close in silently, by night or in the fog; never against vehicles). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightFeint: Multiplier on the score of the feint plan (a small group shows itself and opens fire while the main group strikes from another axis; needs 2 players or more, or a target in a base). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightHarass: Multiplier on the score of the harassment plan (a sniper team on high ground plus mortar rounds, no assault; needs 3 players or more, or a target in a base). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.WeightVehicleHunt: Multiplier on the score of the vehicle hunt plan (a road ambush ahead of a moving tracked vehicle, its scenario drawn with the AmbushWeight keys). 0 turns it off, 2 makes it twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightATTeam: Weight of the anti-vehicle team ambush (a team on the roadside with launchers). Relative chance among the road ambush scenarios the situation allows: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely. If every scenario has 0 weight, this one is used.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightLShape: Weight of the L-shaped ambush (a second group closes the far end of the kill zone; needs 2 free group slots). Relative chance among the road ambush scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightMines: Weight of the mines-and-fire ambush (TM-62M mines on the road plus fire; drawn only with the MineChance probability, more likely at night). Relative chance among the scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightTrap: Weight of the trap ambush (a second group shuts the door behind the target; needs 2 free group slots). Relative chance among the road ambush scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightBait: Weight of the bait ambush (a roadblock or wreck on an asphalt road with a few PMN-4 mines around it). Relative chance among the scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightFPVCorridor: Weight of the FPV corridor ambush (a drone team next to the ambush; needs 2 free group slots and drones not grounded by weather). Relative chance among the scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightNightClose: Weight of the close night ambush (special forces at close range; only in the dark). Relative chance among the scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightLongRange: Weight of the long-range hunter ambush (by clear daylight, a gun or missile vehicle with its guard, or a drone team, on a crest 800 to 1500 m off the road with a view of the kill zone). Relative chance among the scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.AmbushWeightJunction: Weight of the pre-registered junction ambush (a junction ahead that the mortars registered beforehand, a mine to stop the vehicle on it, strike called when the ambush is sprung). Relative chance among the scenarios allowed: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.MineMethodWeightScript: Weight of laying the mines of a mines-and-fire ambush by script: mines on the road before the target comes, removed out of sight of the players afterwards. Relative chance among the three methods: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely. If all weights are 0, script is used.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.MineMethodWeightSappers: Weight of laying the mines with a sapper of the ambush who walks to the road, kneels, lays each mine and lifts them once the players are gone. Relative chance among the three methods: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.
$profile:INDFORGE_EnemyHQ/config.json.MineMethodWeightDrone: Weight of laying the mines with a drone of the ambush drone team, dropping one mine per trip and flying again to lift them. Needs 2 free group slots and drones not grounded, otherwise never drawn. Relative chance among the three methods: 0 = never, 2 = twice as likely.

$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.DroneEnabled: true: a player is warned when a drone starts watching his area. false: this alert is never sent.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.DroneRadius: Meters. Players within this horizontal distance of the target the drone has just started to watch (only players of a faction enemy to the drone's faction, living, and with a radio if RequireRadio) get the alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.DroneTitle: Title of the pop-up shown to the player for the drone alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.DroneText: Text of the pop-up shown for the drone alert (no placeholder used).
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.InterceptEnabled: true: players are warned when the enemy HQ sends a group toward their sector (not for ambush groups nor infiltrations). false: this alert is never sent.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.InterceptRadius: Meters. Players within this horizontal distance of the tracked position the group is sent to (living, with a radio if RequireRadio) get the alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.InterceptTitle: Title of the pop-up shown to the player for the intercept alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.InterceptText: Text of the pop-up for the intercept alert. %1 is replaced by the compass direction (from the Directions list) of the group's starting point, seen from the player.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MortarEnabled: true: players are warned when an observed enemy mortar fire mission starts its ranging rounds. false: this alert is never sent.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MortarRadius: Meters. Players within this horizontal distance of the fire mission target (living, with a radio if RequireRadio) get the alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MortarTitle: Title of the pop-up shown to the player for the mortar alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MortarText: Text of the pop-up shown for the mortar alert (no placeholder used).
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.GeranEnabled: true: players are warned when the first drone of an enemy Geran raid is launched. false: this alert is never sent.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.GeranRadius: Meters. Players within this horizontal distance of the raid's target (living, with a radio if RequireRadio) get the alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.GeranTitle: Title of the pop-up shown to the player for the Geran alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.GeranText: Text of the pop-up for the Geran alert. %1 is replaced by the name of the targeted base.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MissileEnabled: true: players are warned when an enemy cruise missile is ordered on a base the players took (only if the weather does not ground aircraft, no enemy soldier is near the base, and it is not the main base). false: this alert is never sent.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MissileRadius: Meters. Players within this horizontal distance of the targeted base (living, with a radio if RequireRadio) get the alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MissileTitle: Title of the pop-up shown to the player for the cruise missile alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.MissileText: Text of the pop-up for the cruise missile alert. %1 is replaced by the name of the targeted base, %2 by the minutes to impact (at least 1).
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.FlybyEnabled: true: each player the pilot of an enemy recon jet pass sees is warned. false: this alert is never sent.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.FlybyTitle: Title of the pop-up shown to the player for the jet flyby alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.FlybyText: Text of the pop-up shown for the jet flyby alert (no placeholder used).
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.AmbushEnabled: true: players of a vehicle may be warned of a road ambush laid ahead of them (only with AmbushHintChance probability). false: this alert is never sent.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.AmbushRadius: Meters. Players within this horizontal distance of the tracked vehicle's predicted position when the ambush is laid (living, with a radio if RequireRadio) get the alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.AmbushTitle: Title of the pop-up shown to the player for the road ambush alert.
$profile:INDFORGE_RadioAlerts/config.jso.AmbushText: Text of the pop-up shown for the road ambush alert (no placeholder used).

$profile:INDFORGE_Movement/config.json.BushSlowdown: false (default): no slowdown in bushes, as before game update 1.7. true: the vanilla game's slowdown in bushes. Read once at server start and sent to every player.
